current_state.description: A dictionary containing the current state of the tool

current_wear_um.description: Current measured wear of the tool. If not provided, recommendations that strictly require it might fail.

current_material.description: Identifier for the current material being machined. Filters out candidates that don't match.

current_coating.description: Identifier for the current coating of the tool. Filters out candidates that don't match.

status.description: Whether a valid recommendation could be produced.

expected_wear_rate.description: The empirically derived expected wear rate for this specific configuration.

productivity_metric.description: The unnormalized productivity metric (MRR proportional: n * fz * Ap).

alternatives.description: The number of other feasible candidates that passed all constraints but scored lower.

violations_count.description: The number of candidates that were rejected due to constraint violations.

reason.description: Explanation of why no recommendation was generated.

violations.description: List of dictionaries detailing constraint violations for the considered candidates.

safety_rules: REJECT_UNSUPPORTED_CONFIGURATIONS: The system only recommends exact n/fz/Ap combinations that exist in the historical data.
REJECT_SET_1: Configurations from dataset Set 1 are not valid candidates.
RUL_CONSTRAINT: If `current_wear_um` is provided, it predicts wear until end of required cycles, rejecting combinations exceeding failure thresholds.
FAIL_SAFE: Invalid or severely missing state leading to an empty feasible candidate set produces NO_RECOMMENDATION instead of a guess.
